### Props

| Name                | Type     | Required | Default                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `appName`           | `string` | ✓        | —                                            | Display name of the host app, interpolated into the body copy (e.g. "Decidesk", "OpenRegister"). Required.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `appSlug`           | `string` | ✓        | —                                            | Kebab-case app id used as the localStorage namespace by `useSupportDialog`. Required so two apps mounted in the same Nextcloud session don't share a "shown" flag.                                                                                               |
| `appStoreUrl`       | `string` | ✓        | —                                            | Nextcloud App Store listing URL for the host app — opens in a new tab when the "Review on App Store" CTA fires. Required.                                                                                                                                        |
| `featureRequestUrl` | `string` | ✓        | —                                            | URL the "Suggest a feature" CTA opens (typically the host app's GitHub issues "new feature" template). Required.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `donateUrl`         | `string` |          | `'https://github.com/sponsors/ConductionNL'` | URL the "Donate" CTA opens. Defaults to ConductionNL's GitHub Sponsors page so apps that haven't set up their own donation channel still have a working button.                                                                                                  |
| `supportUrl`        | `string` |          | `'https://www.conduction.nl/contact'`        | URL the "Get business support" CTA opens. Defaults to the Conduction contact page. The copy frames this CTA for organisations, not individuals.                                                                                                                  |
| `founderName`       | `string` |          | `'Ruben van der Linde'`                      | Name rendered in the handwritten signature line. Defaults to Ruben van der Linde; overridable so a future Conduction-adjacent consumer can sign their own apps.                                                                                                  |
| `founderTitle`      | `string` |          | `'Founder'`                                  | Title shown after the signature (e.g. "Founder", "Oprichter"). Defaults to the English `Founder` — translated body copy already carries the localised noun in the paragraphs above, so the label here is intentionally short.                                    |
| `bodyParagraphs`    | `array`  |          | `[]`                                         | Optional body-copy override. When non-empty, the array is rendered verbatim — one `<p>` per entry — and the built-in Conduction copy is skipped. Useful for one-off campaigns (release announcement, new pricing) where the founder note is not the right voice. |

### Events

| Name     | Payload | Description                                                                                                                                                             |
| -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `close`  | —       | Emitted when the user dismisses the dialog (backdrop click, ESC, close icon). Pair with `useSupportDialog().hide` to also persist the dismissal.                        |
| `action` | —       | Fired alongside the native `window.open` call on each CTA click. Useful for analytics or to short-circuit the default open-in-new-tab behaviour from a parent listener. |
